day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadka Afraad iyo Soddonka ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Kiristoow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Aan u heesno Rabbiga, waayo isagu waa weyn yahay oo waa boqor weligiis ah.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan geeska waddada magaalada oo aad daawanayso webi biyo nadiif ah oo dhex maraya bartamaha magaalada. Waxaa jira wax dagan oo nadiif ah oo ku saabsan biyaha qulqulaya; biyahaasi waxay nolosha u horseedaan wax walba oo ay taabtaan. Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee kitaabka Muujintii, Yooxanaa wuxuu arkay 'webiga biyaha nolosha' oo ka soo burqanaya carshiga Ilaah. Waxa ugu quruxda badan ee uu arkay ma aha oo kaliya biyaha, ee waa geedka nolosha oo labada dhinac ee webiga ka baxaya, kaas oo caleemihiisu ay yihiin daawo u ah quruumaha. Waa sawirka nabadda ugu dambaysa. Waa meel aanay dhib iyo murugo midna ka jirin, meel aanay u baahnayn iftiinka qorraxda, maxaa yeelay Rabbiga laftiisa ayaa ah iftiinkooda.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba u taagnaa inuu wax barto, inuu ogaado sida dunidu u shaqeyso, iyo inuu jacaylkiisa la wadaago qoyskiisa. Waxaan xusuustaa sida uu u jeclaa inuu la wadaago aabbihiis xamaasadda uu u qabay diyaaradaha. Waxa uu xitaa ku riyoon jiray inuu abuuro shirkad uu ugu magac daray 'con chim airlines'. Markuu ka hadlayay shirkaddan uu ku riyoonayay, wuxuu had iyo jeer ku darsan jiray qosol iyo dhoola caddayn. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u dhalaalaya, laakiin waxaa ka sii qurux badnaa qalbiyadiisa oo u furnaa adduunka. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu dadka kale ka farxiyo, wiil leh naxariis aan xad lahayn. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil si dhab ah u aaminsanaa in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiim ah.'

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Is ilaaliya in qalbiyadiinnu ay noqdaan kuwo culus.' Waa digniin ku saabsan welwelka iyo mashquulka nolosha oo inaga dhigi kara kuwo aan arki karin joogitaanka Ilaah. Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'toos u istaagno' oo aan 'tukanno' si aan u helno xoog aan uga gudubno dhibaatada. 'Toos u istaaga' macnaheedu waa inaanan quusan, inaanan madaxa hoos u dhigin, ee aan indhahayaga kor u eegno dhanka Jannada. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba 'indhaha u furan' xagga waxyaalaha quruxda badan ee Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil had iyo jeer raadinayay inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah kuwa 'guulaystay' ee jacaylka ku dhex faafiya dadka kale.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira waqtiyo marka aad dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid bannaan, saacado marka aad xusuusataan dhoola caddayntiisa ama sida uu u jeclaa inuu qoslo markaad ka hadlaysaan 'con chim airlines.' Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in dunidiinnu ay u muuqato mid isbedelaysa, sidii geedka oo kale xilliga dayrta. Laakiin fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Adigu keligaa ma tihid. Ben wuxuu hadda ku dhex nool yahay 'webiga biyaha nolosha' ee Yooxanaa arkay, meel aanay jirin ilmo ama murugo. Jacaylkiinna, dadaalkiinnii, iyo sida aad u koriseen wiilkan cajiibka ah waa mid aan marnaba lumin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil doonayay inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Xusuusta uu aabbihiis ka sheegay ee ku saabsan sida uu u rabay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William, waa tusaale saafi ah oo ah wiil qalbigiisu uu furnaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno. Ben wuxuu bixiyay qalbigiisa oo dhan, taasna waa waxa maanta ka dhigaya inuu ku dhex noolaado jannada.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuxuu idin leeyahay, 'Behold, I am coming soon.' Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo gal ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan ku duubayaa sidii adigoo hore u joogay, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga. Ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwa dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nasasho iyo iftiin weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah siiyo qalbi qaboojiye iyo rajo xoog leh oo ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Yooxanaa wuxuu yidhi: Malaa'igtii waxay i tustay webiga biyaha nolosha, oo dhalaalaya sida kristal, oo ka soo qulqulaya carshiga Ilaah iyo kan Wanka, oo dhex maraya bartamaha waddada. Labada dhinac ee webiga waxaa ka baxay geedkii nolosha oo midho dhala laba iyo toban jeer sannadkii, mar kasta oo bil cusub timaado; caleemaha geedaha waxay u adeegaan sidii daawo u ah quruumaha. Wax habaar ah mar dambe ma jiri doono. Carshiga Ilaah iyo kan Wanka ayaa ku dhex jiri doona, addoommaduna way caabudi doonaan. Waxay arki doonaan wejigiisa, magiciisuna wuxuu ku qornaan doonaa wejigooda. Habeen mar dambe ma jiri doono, uma baahnaan doonaan iftiin laambad ama qorrax, waayo Rabbiga Ilaah ayaa siin doona iftiin, wayna boqortooyo ahaan doonaan weligood iyo weligood. Malaa'igtii waxay igu tidhi, 'Ereyadan waa kuwo la aamini karo oo run ah, Rabbigii, Ilaaha ruuxyada nabiyada, wuxuu soo diray malaa'igtiisii si uu addoommadiisa u tuso waxa dhici doona dhawaan. Bal eeg, waxaan imanayaa dhawaan.' Waxaa barakaysan kan haya farriinta nabiga ee kitaabkan.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi: 'Is ilaaliya in qalbiyadiinnu ay noqdaan kuwo culus oo ay ka daalaan dabaaldeg, sakhraannimo, iyo welwelka nolosha maalinlaha ah, si aanay maalintaas idiinku iman si lama filaan ah sida dabin oo kale. Waayo maalintaas waxay ku soo dhici doontaa qof kasta oo dunida ku nool. Had iyo jeer feejignaada oo tukada si aad u heshaan xoog aad uga baxsataan dhibaatooyinka soo socda oo aad u hor istaagtaan Wiilka Aadanaha.'

day: Saturday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
